name: MMPD-SM
description: The widespread adoption of social media platforms has resulted in a rapid growth of multimodal data, which contain rich personality cues. Most existing approaches primarily focus on textual analysis, neglect the more abundant and intertwined personalityrelated information present across different modalities. To address these gaps, we introduce MMPD-SM, a pioneering multimodal personality detection dataset comprising 5,322 user profiles from X and 2,398 from Reddit. Based on this dataset, we propose a novel Multimodal Personality Detection Framework (MMPDF) that integrates both textual and visual modalities from social media content for personality detection. Specifically, for the textual modality, we employ a Large Language Model (LLM) to extract MBTI-related features and subsequently enhance the original textual representations using these features. For the visual modality, we extract tone, color, and image style information from both post images and user avatars, which are relevant to user personality traits. Finally, we design a task-specific adaptive fusion mechanism that can adaptively adjust the fusion weights of different modalities. Experiments on MMPD-SM demonstrate that MMPDF achieves optimal performance in multimodal personality detection, providing new insights into personality detection based on social media data.
reputation: New multimodal dataset with limited adoption so far (introduced in a recent preprint).
notes: Multimodal social-media data with privacy and ethical concerns; labels may be noisy/inferred (personality annotations). Moderate dataset size (several thousand profiles) — risk of domain shift across platforms and demographic bias. Uses LLM-extracted features in the proposed pipeline.
